footnotes.text: Protection for exposures shall mean fire protection for structures on property adjacent to tanks. When acceptable to the authority having jurisdiction, such structures located (1) within the jurisdiction of any public fire department or (2) within or adjacent to plants having private fire brigades shall be considered as having adequate protection for exposures.
